note: Agent executable work. Distinct from editorial/evidence/debt, which holds authorial obligations requiring the author's judgment. Tier governs what may run unattended.

tiers.green: Mechanical and reversible. May run unattended.
tiers.amber: May run, must be surfaced. Changes a rule, a voice card, a schema, or a gate.
tiers.red: Never unattended. Canon, claim scope, outward facing, or publishing.

tasks.title: Rule on passes that resolved an open question by deleting its evidence
tasks.detail: Found in Volume II and named by the agent re-rendering it. R-LEDGER-WINS covers the case where a recorded decision outranks the baseline. The inverse has no rule: no decision exists, and the prior pass made one silently by removing the evidence the open question rested on. CTD-0038 is the clearest instance, conceding in its own words that the change was substantive rather than copyediting, while the pass had already made it. Invisible to every gate, because the shipped prose is cleaner, the word count barely moves, and the result is internally coherent. This is a finding about the pass rather than a prose rule, so it belongs in the debt ledger and the ruling is the author's.

tasks.title: Make bookmarks survive renames, merges, and prose edits
tasks.detail: Author directive 2026-07-31: bookmark reference continuity through successive editorial revisions must exist today. Audit verdict: prose edits degrade to a stale-tagged section-top link; renames break the toolbar panel silently because bookmark-sections.json strips legacy ids and the miss path hardcodes stale false; merges break both surfaces because bookmarksForSection borrows progress group semantics that narrow the identity set (39 sections affected). Fixes: carry legacySectionIds into the bookmark payload and index the toolbar by them; treat an unresolvable section as stale true; widen the bookmark identity set beyond progressKeys; add the failing e2e that seeds a bookmark under a known historical id. Quote-search recovery (rung 3) is a follow-on with a payload cost, offered separately. Landed 2026-07-31: legacy ids carried into the bookmark payload, panel indexes every historical identity, unresolvable sections report stale, and matching unions all identity sets without touching progress semantics. New e2e fails pre-fix and passes post-fix; units 91/91; full fast desktop sweep 95 passed, exit 0. Quote-text recovery deferred as a separate author decision with a payload cost.
